title: A producer zooms in on what they selected

steps.caption: BD has one clip in bar 1, and Sampler has clips in bars 1 to 3
Drag from mid bar 2 on BD to mid bar 4 on Sampler: two clips selected
Zoom to selection: exactly the dragged stretch fills the timeline
Click the clip in bar 3 and press Z: bar 3 fills the timeline
Reopened with nothing selected, so there is nothing to zoom to
